meta.title: Hi Scoot | The city moves. Get in the Flow.
meta.description: Rent e-scooters and e-bikes from people in your city, or list yours and earn extra income.

footer.slogan: The city moves. Get in the Flow.

home.title: The new Hi Scoot website is under construction
home.description: Soon you will be able to rent and list e-scooters and e-bikes here.

designSystem.title: Hi Scoot website building blocks
designSystem.intro: This page shows every building block that repeats across screens, with all its variations. Check each one and switch the language at the top to see the Portuguese text.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: A single list of colors that every screen follows. Changing a color here changes it across the whole website.

type.title: Typeface
type.description: Inter across the whole website, in four main sizes.
type.sampleBody: Rent an e-scooter near you and pay per day.

icons.title: Official icons
icons.description: The 19 Hi Scoot icons. When one is missing, we use one from the Lucide library.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Six button types. Hover and click to see the hover and pressed states.

fields.title: Text fields
fields.description: Normal field, with a hint, with an error and disabled.
fields.emailHint: We will send the confirmation to this email.
fields.priceError: Enter an amount greater than zero.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Every content block has four states: loaded, loading, empty and error.
cards.emptyText: Try another neighborhood or change the filters.
cards.errorText: Check your connection and try again.

badges.title: Status labels
badges.description: Show the status of a listing or a booking.

toast.title: Quick notice
toast.description: Shows at the top of the screen for a few seconds and disappears on its own.
toast.errorText: Please try again in a moment.

dialog.title: Confirmation window
dialog.description: Asks for confirmation before an important action. The red button only appears when the action cannot be undone.
dialog.normalText: The Rider will be notified and can make the payment.

header.title: Main menu with language selector
header.description: Always at the top. The PT/EN selector is part of the menu. On mobile, the menu links move to the bottom bar.

bottomNav.title: Bottom bar (mobile)
bottomNav.description: Only on mobile, for logged-in people, fixed to the bottom of the screen.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links will be added once those texts are ready.
